decision_1.rule: IG below posterior-|PCC| in >= 7/8 sections and mean <= -0.02 at every applicable scale, at seeds 2 and 3, in every collection x arm with a complete seed

RCC.metric: IG mSCF1 at K_bin (bin) and P1 matched K_peak; uniform_mean - central_only

CAC.metric: IG mSCF1 at K_bin (bin) and P1 matched K_peak; uniform_mean - central_only

GBM.metric: IG mSCF1 at K_bin (bin) and P1 matched K_peak; uniform_mean - central_only

notes.GBM: 8 sections from 4 patients; sections are not independent patients
notes.CAC: CAC P1 is singleton groups (1,481 for 1,481 bins), so its peak-level score is the bin-level score at the K_peak budget; requiring both is a two-budget check, not an independent partition check
notes.RCC: bin level only (protocol 18 Section 6.1 amendment, 17 October); unannotated class, 45-78% of pixels; the dataset's own Cardinal workflow treats these pixels as background (rcc_nobg), but this was not independently verified; GMM K = 3 is class-informed

sd_definition: sample standard deviation over the available seeds (ddof = 1)
